test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B can finish a project in 10 days, B and C can finish it in 20 days, and C and A can finish it in 30 days. If A, B and C work together, they will finish the project in:
solution:
**GIVEN:**

A and B can finish a project in 10 days.

B and C can finish it in 20 days.

C and A can finish it in 30 days.

**FORMULA USED:**

Efficiency = Total work / Time

**SOLUTION:**

Let the total work done by A, B, and C be 60 units.

Efficiency of A + B = 6 units.

Efficiency of B + C = 3 units.

Efficiency of C + A = 2 units.

Efficiency of 2 (A + B + C) = 11 units

Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 11 / 2 units

Hence time taken by A, B, C = 60 / (11 / 2) = 120 / 11 days

Hence option 1 is the valid answer.
